Acquired 2026-10-29 from Poly Haven and ambientCG, sources recommended in `Docs/RTS_ASSET_RESOURCE_RESEARCH.md`. Raw source material is staged for future review; nothing here has been imported into Unreal, cooked, or bound to gameplay/content definitions.

| Modular Factory Facade | James Ray Cock (Poly Haven) | 1K textures | Industrial plant, rail-yard, depot, or workshop environment modules | https://polyhaven.com/a/modular_factory_facade |
| Metal 063 | ambientCG / Lennart Demes | 2K-JPG | Weathered industrial steel and machinery surface | https://ambientcg.com/a/Metal063 |

## License and provenance

Poly Haven states that all its assets are CC0; ambientCG states that all assets are CC0 1.0 Universal. Publisher license captures are in `PolyHaven-LICENSE-source.html` and `ambientCG-LICENSE-source.html`. Attribution is not required but is retained. The Poly Haven source API files and ambientCG download metadata are preserved alongside each asset. `SHA256SUMS` covers every included file.

The façade is generic industrial architecture and the metal is generic surface material; neither proves a specific Yugoslav design or location. Check historical-art fit, import scale/material channels, collision, platform memory, and RTS-camera readability before integration. Keep visual-only elements from silently changing gameplay navigation.
